import { existsSync } from 'node:fs'
import { readFile } from 'node:fs/promises'
import { homedir } from 'node:os'
import { join, resolve } from 'node:path'
import { createOpenAI } from '@ai-sdk/openai'
import { useServerEnv } from '#vitehub/env/server'
import { defineAgent } from 'vite-hub/agent'
import { discord as discordChannel } from 'vite-hub/agent/channels'
import type { DiscordAdapterOptions } from 'vite-hub/agent/channels'
import { gmail, progressSummary, schedule, title, transcribe } from 'vite-hub/agent/capabilities'

const codexAuth = join(process.env.CODEX_HOME || join(homedir(), '.codex'), 'auth.json')

export default defineAgent({
  box: {
    runtime: { kind: 'trusted-host', stateRoot: resolve('.data/boxes') },
    home: {
      files: existsSync(codexAuth) ? {
        '.codex/auth.json': { contents: () => readFile(codexAuth) },
        '.codex/config.toml': { contents: 'cli_auth_credentials_store = "file"\n' },
      } : {},
    },
  },
  runtime: false,
  driver: {
    kind: 'codex',
    instructions: '{{ workspace.instructions }}',
    model: 'model',
    reasoningEffort: 'high',
  },
  channels: {
    discord: discordChannel({
      adapter: {
        applicationId: useServerEnv().discord.applicationId,
        respondToChannelIds: [useServerEnv().discord.channelId],
        botToken: useServerEnv().discord.botToken,
        longContent: { mode: 'split' },
        publicKey: useServerEnv().discord.publicKey,
        userName: 'mini',
      } as DiscordAdapterOptions,
      messages: {
        concurrency: 'queue',
        delivery: 'manual',
        errorFallbackText: 'The work did not finish. Send the message again.',
        fallbackStreamingPlaceholderText: 'Thinking…',
        lockScope: 'agent',
        timeout: 240_000,
        threadHistory: { maxMessages: 25 },
        triggerHistory: { maxMessages: 25, source: 'thread' },
        userName: 'mini',
      },
    }),
  },
  capabilities: [
    progressSummary({
      driver: {
        kind: 'codex',
        model: 'model',
        reasoningEffort: 'low',
      },
      intervalMs: 5000,
    }),
    gmail({ operations: ['search', 'read', 'draft'] }),
    schedule({
      allowSelfTarget: true,
      delivery: 'origin',
      mode: 'write',
      timeZone: 'Europe/Stockholm',
    }),
    title({
      driver: {
        kind: 'codex',
        model: 'model',
        reasoningEffort: 'low',
      },
      maxLength: 35,
    }),
    transcribe(() => {
      const { bitacora, openai } = useServerEnv()
      const root = bitacora.discordInputRoot.replace(/^\/+|\/+$/g, '') || 'inputs/discord-audio'

      return {
        maxBytes: 25 * 1024 * 1024,
        model: createOpenAI({
          apiKey: openai.apiKey.unseal(),
        }).transcription(openai.transcriptionModel),
        artifacts: {
          audio: true,
          transcript: {
            path: ({ date, stem }) => `${root}/${date}/${stem}.md`,
            mediaType: 'text/markdown',
          },
        },
      }
    }),
  ],
  workspace: {
    bindings: { instructions: { path: 'AGENTS.md' } },
    commit: 'chore: update journal',
    mode: 'write',
    store: {
      branch: 'main',
      provider: 'github',
      repository: 'example/journal',
      root: '/',
    },
  },
})
